extracted.intended_audience: applicants preparing NIH grant Biographical Sketch and Research Support sections (Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and examples for completing the NIH Biographical Sketch (A–D) and the Research Support section for Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors; includes required fields, formatting, and content guidance (page limits, what to include/exclude, relevance statements, and example entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the prescribed A–D section headings (A. Personal Statement; B. Positions and Honors; C. Contribution to Science; D. Additional Information: Research Support). Follow the format for each person and keep the entire Biographical Sketch to no more than five pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training section content and format
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include columns/fields: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); Completion Date MM/YYYY; FIELD OF STUDY. Add or remove rows to reflect the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (Section A)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Personal Statement that summarizes the individual's expertise and relevance to the proposed project (why the person is well suited to their role).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State long-standing interests, relevant prior contributions, specific expertise, previous collaborations, and how those skills/resources will support the current proposal. In examples, authors explicitly include 'Relevance to this proposal' describing tasks, specimen/resource contributions, and roles in proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors (Section B)
rubrics_metrics.description: List Positions and Employment and Honors relevant to the applicant's career.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide dates and titles for positions and list fellowships/awards/honors. Use chronological or otherwise clear ordering (examples show positions with date ranges and named honors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contribution to Science (Section C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe major contributions to science, organized by topic, with a concise narrative and selected citations for each topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each topic present: a short statement of the contribution/area, explanation of the significance and context, and selected key publications (with full citations). Number topics (e.g., 1), provide narrative evidence of impact, and include key publications related to each contribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key publications and citation practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Include selected key publications within the Biographical Sketch and provide identifiers (e.g., PMCID) when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite full references for key publications and include PMCID or other identifiers where possible. Provide a link to the complete list of published work in MyBibliography for a full publication record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support: scope and selection (Section D)
rubrics_metrics.description: List both selected ongoing and completed research projects for the past three years (Federal or non-Federally-supported). Begin with the projects that are most relevant to the research proposed in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include both ongoing and completed projects (from past three years), and order by relevance to the current application. Briefly indicate the overall goals of each project and the responsibilities of the key person named on the Biographical Sketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support entry required elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Research Support entry should identify the grant/project number, dates, sponsor, project title, and concise statement of major goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show format such as: '5 R01 AI054359 (Iwasaki) 12/01/2003 - 03/31/2019 NIH/NIAID Immunity to Genital Herpes Simplex Virus 2' followed by a brief statement of major goals. Include the role/responsibilities of the Biographical Sketch holder.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support exclusions and format constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not include number of person months or direct costs in the Research Support descriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When describing projects, briefly indicate goals and responsibilities only; exclude administrative/fiscal details such as person-month commitments or budget/direct cost figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completed Research Support timeframe constraint
rubrics_metrics.description: When listing Completed Research Support, limit entries to the last three years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Label completed support as 'Completed Research Support (last three years)' and include only projects that finished within that three-year window preceding submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide complete bibliography via MyBibliography link
rubrics_metrics.description: Supply a link to the applicant’s complete list of published work in MyBibliography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the full URL to the MyBibliography collection (example: 'Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/myncbi/...'). This supplements the selected key publications listed in the Biographical Sketch.
